description: Create a scoped agent identity and its key. Needs an organization key. Scope it to the operations the agent needs (for example create_order) rather than * where you can. The key (ow_agent_...) is returned once, in this result, and this server does not keep it: store it, and send it as the Authorization bearer on a connection used for the agent tools (tower_capabilities, tower_decide, tower_submit_action, tower_get_action, tower_compensate, tower_get_receipt, tower_verify_receipts). Revoke with tower_revoke_agent.

name.description: A name a person will recognise in the review queue, e.g. order-intake-bot

scopes.description: Operation names this agent may call, or ["*"] for all

use_for_session.description: Ignored here. The hosted server has no session and never holds a key; it exists so calls written for the npm package still validate.

name: tower_create_agent
title: Create an agent identity (Overwing Tower)
